subject: cannot coerce type 'environment' to vector of type 'any'

messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: cannot coerce type 'environment' to vector of type 'any'
parts:
I just updated my version of R, and was forced to re-install my packages.  After updating everything, I am getting the following error when trying to run my shiny app locally:

Error in as.vector(x, mode) : 
  cannot coerce type 'environment' to vector of type 'any'

Nothing in my code changed between updating the R version and re-installing packages.  I think this has something to do with R automatically classifying a variable as an environment variable when it is referenced from another function even if that result of the function is a matrix or data frame.  I've never had this issue before, and seems like it may be some setting got changed during the update.  Any help is much appreciated.

Thanks!
Josh
